senses.gloss: Raudra^1 (“son of Rudra”) = Skanda: I, 5431; III, 14632.
Raudra^4, son of Śukra. § 98 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2545 (? dvau anyau Raudrakarmiṇau, enumeration of the sons of Śukra).

*Raudra^5, adj. (“belonging to Rudra (i.e. Śiva) or to the Rudras”). § 214 (Hiḍimbavadhap.): I, 154, 6028 (muhūrte). --§ 442 (Nivātakavacayuddhap.): III, 167, 11985 (mahāstraṃ, given to Arjuna by Śiva).--§ 445 (do.): III, 173, 12238 (mahāstraṃ, employed by Arjuna), 12240 (astraṃ).-§ 496 (Skandotpatti): III, 224, 14268 (muhūrte).--§ 506 (Skandayuddha): III, 231, 14554 (chattraṃ).--§ 524c (Vishṇu): III, 272, 15824 (sṛjate Brahmamūrtis tu rakshate Paurushī tanuḥ | Raudrībhāvena śamayet tisro 'vasthāḥ Prajāpateḥ).--§ 552d (Arjuna): IV, 61, 1982 (astraṃ, obtained by Arjuna from Śiva).--§ 569 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 138, 4683 (astraṃ, all. to Nivātakavacay.).--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 169, 5870 (astragrāmaḥ, sc. Arjuna's).-§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 1041 (sc. dhanūratnaṃ), 1042 (dhanuḥ, owned by Abhimanyu, who got it from Balarāma).--§ 598 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 88, 3123 (muhūrte).--§ 603d (Tripura): VII, 202, 9561 (ºā bhavishyanti paśavaḥ).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 64, 3237 (astravegena, B. Aindreṇa for Raudreṇa); 82, †4192 (muhūrte); 89, †4611 (do.); 90, 4708 (ºmahāstrasambhṛtaṃ, sc. mahāśaraṃ), 4733 (astraṃ, employed by Arjuna); 94, 4920 (muhūrte).--§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 46, 2654 (ºyaḥ, sc. mātaraḥ).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 77, 3716 (tejas). --§ 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4130 (ºṃ lohitaṃ, “the blood of Agni is regarded as the source of the Rudras,” PCR.).--§ 773d (Śiva): XIII, 161, 7484 (ºā bhavishyanti paśavaḥ).
Raudra, pl., name of a people (BR.). § 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 83, 2476 (-Andhrairaudrair-). Cf. Audra, pl.
Raudrāśva, a prince. § 150 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3695 (son of Pūru and Paushṭi), 3698 (begat on Miśrakeśī ten sons, Ṛceyu, etc.).

Raudrakarman, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2739.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4551.--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 127, 5178 (attacked Bhīmasena), (), 5205 (slain by Bhīmasena).
Raudrāstra (“the weapon of Rudra”). § 445 (Nivātakavacayuddhap.): III, 173, 12254 (employed by Arjuna). Cf. Raudra, adj.
